proof_limits: Office-suite archive was not duplicated into an 83,992,113-byte extracted fixture. All 5,614 archive files were compared byte-for-byte against the existing built tree before running that byte-equivalent tree.
Only office matcher/report_get/report_export_csv calls were exercised. Discovery initialized its 48 bundled child servers, but this is not a full office feature regression test.
Source bootstrap used a dependency-complete three-workspace subset, not an entire fresh Git clone; root-only unused marked devDependency omitted.

Node itself and system builtins are external to bundle. Test client imports canonical SDK and fixture helper, but server resolution guards apply to all standalone/office child ESM/CommonJS modules and reject filesystem modules outside the artifact root.
Office manifest has 407 declarations versus 441 actual tools. Its original archive remains pending repack and re-verification; original hashes are retained as historical evidence.

verification_scripts.guard-require.cjs:
const Module=require('node:module'),fs=require('node:fs');const original=Module._resolveFilename;
Module._resolveFilename=function(...args){const path=original.apply(this,args);if(path.startsWith('/')){if(!path.startsWith(process.env.ARTIFACT_ROOT+'/'))throw Error('Outside artifact CJS resolution: '+path);fs.appendFileSync(process.env.RESOLUTION_LOG,JSON.stringify({kind:'cjs',path})+'\n');}return path;};
